articles.summary: CLINTON, N.J., April 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Unity Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: UNTY), parent company of Unity Bank, reported net income of $14.3 million, or $1.40 per diluted share, for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, compared to net income of $15.5 million, or $1.52 per diluted share for the quarter ended December 31, 2025.
